caseName: Deen v. Gulf, Colorado & Santa Fe Railway Co.
caseNameFull: Deen v. Gulf, Colorado & Santa Fe Railway Co.
attorneys: David C. McCord and Robert Lee Guthrie for petitioner. Luther Hudson for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Texas denied in view of the order entered this day in Deen v. Hickman, ante, p. 57.

Mr. Justice Stewart took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
